events.title: Demo Patch: The Multi-Page Jotpad Has Arrived!
events.summary: Hello investigators! Today's patch brings a few improvements aimed at making it easier to keep your thoughts and your notes sorted, plus a few little nice-to-haves.The Jotpad now supports multiple pages! Instead of one big pile of notes and quotes, you can now create and name an endless number of pages to separate out your thoughts as you're talking to the suspects. events.summary: Greetings investigators! We have another update for you that should help smooth out some of the early game onboarding wrinkles. The tutorial popups have been revamped to replace the static images with nice, easily understood video explanations of how the mechanics of the game work.
